parsed.summary: The patch resolves the issue of TypeError when comparing UnrecognizedUnit with None, but it may introduce unexpected behavior for other None comparisons.

issues.description: The change modifies the behavior of None comparisons, which might affect other parts of the code that rely on the exception being raised.
